selection: Score-blind paired samples from last old negative endpoint + fixed offsets, capped at held start -0.25. All samples reviewed, not only model errors. Held midpoint ±.3 s audit on four awkward takes.
annotation: Known separated hand plus block -> negative; hand absent separately flagged and not added; possible contact unknown. Held-pause state visually audited, no new positive training labels. Training-only additions.
weights: Original equal take/class/view versus equal negative weight among old interiors, old VIDEO04 withdrawal events and newly reviewed pre-contact events, within each take/class/view.
evaluation: All previous panels plus newly selected excluded-take pre-contact samples and held midpoint low-motion panels. Previously inspected takes and source sessions; exploratory, correlated frames, no independent event/session success claim.
qualification: Must reduce false-held transition errors without erasing labelled held recall. Results are observation diagnostics only. Never confer motor control authority.
